title: 누구랑 같이 가요? 이랑/랑으로 말하기
objective: By the end, you can choose 이랑 or 랑 by looking at the last sound of a noun. You can also use it to list things ("A and B") and to say who you do something with ("with A").
summary: Learn to use the particle (이)랑 to say "and" between nouns and "with" a person in everyday spoken Korean.

task.title: Use 이랑 and 랑
task.line: Look at the last sound of each noun: if it ends in a consonant, use 이랑; if it ends in a vowel, use 랑. Then choose, fill in, fix, or write the sentence.

forms.when: The noun ends in a consonant (it has a 받침), for example 빵, 물, 책.
forms.means: "and" between two nouns. It is used in everyday speech.
forms.exampleMeaning: I bought bread and milk at the convenience store.

forms.when: The noun ends in a vowel (it has no 받침), for example 사과, 커피, 친구.
forms.means: "and" between two nouns. The meaning is the same as 이랑. Only the form is different.

forms.when: Use it after a person to say who you do something with. 같이 ("together") often comes after it, but you can leave it out.
forms.exampleMeaning: I'm going to the park with my younger sibling this weekend.

watchOut: 커피이랑 (X) → 커피랑 (O): 커피 ends in a vowel, so add 랑.
물랑 (X) → 물이랑 (O): ㄹ is also a final consonant, so add 이랑.
제랑 (X) → 저랑 (O): To say "with me", use 저랑. 제 is used before 가 (제가) or before a noun to mean "my" (제 책), not before 랑.
exercises: Choose 이랑 or 랑: ① 점심에 김밥(이랑 / 랑) 라면을 먹어요. ② 어제 언니(이랑 / 랑) 백화점에 갔어요. ③ 방에 책상(이랑 / 랑) 의자가 있어요.
Fill in the blank with 이랑 or 랑: 가방에 휴대폰____ 지갑이 있어요.
Fill in the blank with 이랑 or 랑: 토요일에 아빠____ 같이 축구를 해요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 같이 / 저녁을 / 남자 친구랑 / 먹었어요
Find the wrong word and fix it: ① 냉장고에 귤랑 포도가 있어요. ② 오늘 엄마이랑 시장에 가요.
Answer in Korean with (이)랑. The person is 선생님: 어제 누구랑 점심을 먹었어요?
answers: ① 김밥이랑 ② 언니랑 ③ 책상이랑
남자 친구랑 같이 저녁을 먹었어요. (또는: 저녁을 남자 친구랑 같이 먹었어요. / 남자 친구랑 저녁을 같이 먹었어요.)
① 귤랑 → 귤이랑 ② 엄마이랑 → 엄마랑
